news.title: 2027 WASSCE (PC) Jan/Feb First Series Registration at Obama College, Mankessim
news.summary: Register for the 2027 WASSCE for Private Candidates (PC) First Series — the Jan/Feb sitting — at Obama College, Mankessim. Exams run 14 January – 13 February 2027, with special classes taught by WAEC examiners.
news.body:
Registration is now open for the 2027 WASSCE for Private Candidates (PC) First Series at Obama College, Mankessim. This is the WAEC private candidates' examination (WAEC PC) written in January and February, popularly called "Jan/Feb" or "JanFeb". If you want to rewrite WASSCE to improve your grades, resit a subject, or sit the exam for the first time as a private candidate, you can register and write it with us in Mankessim, Central Region.

Jan/Feb or Nov/Dec? WAEC runs two WASSCE (PC) sittings. The First Series is the Jan/Feb sitting. The Second Series, popularly called "Nov/Dec" or "NovDec", comes later in the year. If you were looking for Nov/Dec, the Jan/Feb series is another chance to write WASSCE as a private candidate.

Key details:
Exam: 2027 WASSCE (PC) First Series — Jan/Feb
Exam centre: Obama College, Mankessim
Exam dates: 14th January – 13th February 2027
Special classes: 28th September 2026 – 12th February 2027
Tutors: WAEC examiners
Hostel and boarding: available for interested candidates

Our special classes run right up to the end of the examination period and are taught by WAEC examiners who know exactly what the marking schemes look for. Candidates who need accommodation can stay on campus in our hostel, so you can focus fully on preparing for the exam.

Our WASSCE (PC) candidates have recorded a 100% pass rate. Come and be part of our success story.

How to register: visit the school, or call or WhatsApp 0540 901303 to register for the 2027 WASSCE (PC) and join the special classes.

Location: Obama College, Mankessim — behind Brent Filling Station, on the Accra Highway, Mankessim.

Obaco: You Can!
